description: No-regression smoke gate for the synthetic fixture golden (tests/fixtures/eval/golden.jsonl over mini-ts/py/go). NOT a public quality claim: authoritative retrieval quality is the .benchmarks/ harness on objective PR-derived truth (docs/development-criteria.md, Pillar 1). Baselines are the MEASURED Recall@k / MRR on this golden, recorded from CI (empirically supported on n=126 synthetic queries, not proven, not an outperformance claim). The gate fails only on a regression beyond regression_tolerance. Refresh deliberately when retrieval changes on purpose.
